seo.meta_description: swyMed provides enterprise telemedicine for EMS, ambulances, and rural healthcare. Low-bandwidth video (60kbps+), HL7 EMR integration, HIPAA compliant.

faqs.q: What makes swyMed different from Doxy.me or Zoom Healthcare?
faqs.a: swyMed's core differentiator is reliable video at extremely low bandwidths (60kbps vs 1.5+ Mbps for most platforms). This matters in ambulances, rural areas, and international deployments where connectivity is unreliable. Most therapy practices with standard broadband don't need this.

faqs.q: Is swyMed appropriate for a private therapy practice?
faqs.a: No. swyMed is enterprise-grade infrastructure for health systems, EMS, and rural networks. Solo or small practices would find it overly complex and expensive. Use Doxy.me (free) or Zoom for Healthcare instead.
Enterprise pricing requires custom quotes based on deployment scope. Estimates range $100-500+/month plus hardware costs. No free tier or self-service signup.

faqs.q: What behavioral health use cases fit swyMed?
faqs.a: Mobile crisis teams, telepsychiatry into rural clinics or correctional facilities, and health systems with low-connectivity satellite locations. Not for standard outpatient therapy.

faqs.q: What are the downsides of swyMed?
faqs.a: User reviews cite technical glitches and slow customer support. Enterprise deployment requires IT integration work. Overkill for organizations with reliable connectivity.

one_liner: Enterprise telehealth for EMS, ambulances, and rural care with low-bandwidth video (60kbps+). HL7 EM
